clinicalPearls: Fever pain after tumour work is expected
reference.pathophysiology: Temporary Gelfoam reopens while coils, plugs, particles and liquids close for good; bleeders are followed to mesenteric, splenic, bronchial or maxillary targets, and fever with pain after tumour work signals post-embolisation syndrome rather than infection.

Target versus non-target ischaemia by catheter tip position
